text: This file is the non-vacuity witness for the statement of Erdős problem 1094. The statement has no hypotheses: it asserts outright that the set of exceptional pairs (n, k) is finite. So there is nothing to exhibit, and the witness the gate asks for is the trivial proposition True, proved by trivial. It says nothing about the problem itself; it only records that the statement is not vacuously true by having impossible hypotheses.
